indicators: suspicious login link; spoofed sender; credential submission
description: Employees received a fraudulent password-reset email that redirected them to a fake authentication page. One employee entered their credentials.
response_taken: Blocked the malicious domain, reset affected credentials, reviewed authentication logs, and searched for additional affected accounts.

indicators: multiple failed logins; repeated source IP; account lockouts
description: An external source generated repeated password attempts against several employee accounts over a short period.
response_taken: Blocked the source IP, enabled account lockout controls, reviewed authentication logs, and enforced stronger passwords.

indicators: encrypted files; ransom note; inaccessible documents
description: Multiple shared files became inaccessible after unauthorized encryption activity was detected on the internal file server.
response_taken: Isolated the affected server, stopped suspicious activity, preserved evidence, and restored files from a clean backup.

indicators: malicious input; database errors; abnormal queries
description: A web application received crafted input through a form that caused unexpected database queries and error messages.
response_taken: Blocked malicious requests, disabled the vulnerable endpoint temporarily, corrected input validation, and reviewed database logs.
attack_techniques: Initial Access; Exploitation for Client Execution

indicators: traffic spike; request flood; service disruption
description: A public web server received an unusually large volume of automated requests that caused service degradation.
response_taken: Activated traffic filtering, applied rate limiting, monitored traffic patterns, and restored normal service.

indicators: unknown executable; unusual process; unexpected network connection
description: A suspicious executable was downloaded to an employee laptop and subsequently created unexpected processes and network connections.
response_taken: Isolated the laptop, collected relevant evidence, removed the malicious software, and scanned connected systems.
attack_techniques: Execution; User Execution; Command and Control

indicators: repeated login attempts; reused credentials; multiple accounts targeted
description: Automated login attempts used previously compromised username and password combinations against multiple employee accounts.
response_taken: Forced password resets, blocked suspicious login sources, enabled multi-factor authentication, and reviewed account activity.

indicators: unexpected privileged login; unusual access time; sensitive queries
description: An unfamiliar privileged account accessed a database outside its normal operating pattern and queried sensitive records.
response_taken: Disabled the account, revoked active sessions, preserved logs, reviewed privileged access, and investigated the accessed records.

indicators: large outbound transfer; unusual destination; abnormal database activity
description: A large volume of database records was transferred to an unfamiliar external destination.
response_taken: Blocked the external destination, disabled the affected account, reviewed network and database logs, and assessed potentially exposed information.

indicators: suspicious attachment; macro activity; unusual process
description: An employee received an email containing a malicious attachment. Opening the attachment triggered suspicious activity on the workstation.
response_taken: Removed the message from mailboxes, isolated the affected workstation, blocked the sender, and performed malware analysis.

indicators: repeated VPN failures; unfamiliar source; authentication anomalies
description: A remote source repeatedly attempted to authenticate to the organization's VPN service using different account names.
response_taken: Blocked the source, enabled stronger authentication controls, reviewed VPN logs, and checked targeted accounts.

indicators: unusual file access; large file copy; after-hours activity
description: A user account accessed and copied an unusually large number of sensitive files outside its normal working pattern.
response_taken: Suspended the account temporarily, preserved relevant logs, reviewed access history, and investigated the transferred files.

indicators: unexpected page modification; unauthorized files; altered website
description: The organization's public website was modified without authorization and displayed content that was not part of the approved site.
response_taken: Removed unauthorized changes, restored the website from a trusted version, reviewed access logs, and patched the vulnerable component.

indicators: unusual cloud login; new access key; unexpected resource activity
description: An employee's cloud account showed an unusual login followed by creation of a new access credential and unexpected resource activity.
response_taken: Revoked active sessions and credentials, reset the account, reviewed cloud audit logs, and checked for unauthorized resources.

indicators: unexpected administrator privileges; permission change; suspicious process
description: A compromised user account obtained elevated privileges on an application server and attempted to access restricted resources.
response_taken: Disabled the affected account, removed unauthorized privileges, isolated the server, and reviewed privilege and process logs.
attack_techniques: Privilege Escalation; Exploitation for Privilege Escalation

indicators: multiple host connections; unusual administrative activity; new remote sessions
description: After an initial workstation compromise, suspicious authentication activity was detected across several internal systems.
response_taken: Isolated affected hosts, disabled compromised accounts, reviewed authentication paths, and investigated additional systems.
attack_techniques: Lateral Movement; Remote Services; Valid Accounts

indicators: unauthorized database access; sensitive records; abnormal queries
description: Unauthorized access to a customer database was detected and investigation indicated that sensitive customer information may have been accessed.
response_taken: Restricted database access, preserved evidence, reviewed audit logs, identified affected records, and initiated the organization's incident response process.

indicators: unexpected software update; suspicious code; compromised dependency
description: A software dependency used by the development environment was found to contain unauthorized changes that could affect applications using it.
response_taken: Removed the affected dependency, reviewed build artifacts, checked software integrity, and restricted the compromised component.

indicators: password reset request; unfamiliar login; changed account settings
description: A user reported unexpected password-reset notifications followed by a login from an unfamiliar location and changes to account settings.
response_taken: Reset the password, revoked active sessions, enabled multi-factor authentication, reviewed account activity, and restored legitimate settings.
attack_techniques: Credential Access; Valid Accounts; Account Manipulation

indicators: phishing email; compromised account; internal access; data transfer
description: An attacker initially targeted an employee through phishing, obtained account access, moved to an internal system, and attempted to transfer sensitive information.
response_taken: Isolated affected systems, disabled compromised accounts, reviewed the attack path, blocked suspicious communication, preserved evidence, and initiated recovery procedures.
attack_techniques: Phishing; Valid Accounts; Lateral Movement; Exfiltration
